prompt: Write a Sui Move module for a tagged item collection. Items should have a name and a list of string tags. Include functions to create items, add tags, count tags, and destroy items.
expectations: Code compiles with sui move build
Uses Move 2024 module declaration (semicolon, no outer braces)
Uses method syntax (e.g., vector.push_back(), .length()) instead of legacy function-call syntax

prompt: Write a Move module called 'vector_demo' that demonstrates modern 2024 edition vector operations. Create a vector of u64 values using the vector literal syntax, push 3 items using method syntax, check the length using method syntax, pop the last element, and use the index syntax to read and modify elements. Include a test that verifies all operations.

Write a Move module called 'option_demo' that demonstrates modern 2024 edition option operations. Create an Option<u64> with some(10), check is_some() and is_none() using method syntax, borrow the inner value, extract it, and verify the option is now none. Include a test.

Write a Move module called 'string_demo' that creates strings using byte literal syntax b"hello".to_string(), performs append, checks length, and uses substring. Include a test that verifies the string operations.

Write a Move module called 'event_demo' with an Item struct (has key) and an ItemPurchased event struct (has copy, drop) containing item: ID and price: u64 fields. Write a function that creates an Item, emits an ItemPurchased event using event::emit without explicit type parameters, and returns the Item. Include a test that verifies the event was emitted using event::num_events() and event::events_by_type.

Write a Move module called 'macro_demo' that uses vector macros: count! to count even numbers, map! to double values, fold! to sum all elements, and do! to iterate. Include a test verifying each macro result.
